room_description.en: An elegant hotel dining room frozen in time. White tablecloths have yellowed with age, silverware sits tarnished at each place setting, and a grand stone fireplace dominates the far wall. A large chalkboard menu still displays the specials from 1994. Dried flower arrangements sit in crystal vases, and a wine rack lines the entire left wall. Table 7, near the window, still has a half-eaten meal and an overturned wine glass.
room_description.zh: 一间被时间凝固的优雅酒店餐厅。白色桌布已经泛黄，每套餐具旁的银器已经失去光泽，远处墙壁上有一座宏大的石头壁炉。一块大黑板菜单上仍然显示着1994年的特色菜品。干花插在水晶花瓶中，整面左墙排满了酒架。靠窗的7号桌上还有一顿未吃完的饭菜和一只翻倒的酒杯。

story_fragment.en: Table 7 has a reservation card: 'Mr. E.V. Grandview — Dinner for Two — Oct 14, 8:00 PM.' But the second chair is pulled back, napkin untouched. Whoever was supposed to join him never arrived — or left in a hurry.
story_fragment.zh: 7号桌上有一张预订卡：'E.V. Grandview先生——双人晚餐——10月14日晚8:00。'但第二把椅子被推开，餐巾纸没有动过。原本要来赴约的人从未到达——或者匆忙离开了。

clue_source.en: Each table has a brass number plate and a colored napkin. A wall sign says: 'Service Order: Red, Blue, Gold.'
clue_source.zh: 每张桌子都有一个黄铜桌号牌和彩色餐巾。墙上的告示写着：'服务顺序：红色、蓝色、金色。'

solution_steps.zh: 记录颜色：红色(4号桌)，蓝色(7号桌)，金色(2号桌)。

clue_source.en: Add the prices of the three specials on the chalkboard: $14, $28, $9.
clue_source.zh: 将黑板上三道特色菜的价格相加：$14, $28, $9。

solution_steps.en: Sum is 51. Enter into the kitchen hatch lock.
solution_steps.zh: 总和为51。在厨房传菜窗锁上输入。

clue_source.en: A locked cabinet in the wine rack area requires a 3-digit code.
clue_source.zh: 酒架区域的一个带锁柜子需要一个3位数的密码。

solution_steps.en: Enter '472' (from Table Tally) into the cabinet lock.
solution_steps.zh: 在柜子锁上输入'472'（来自餐桌统计）。

clue_source.en: Use the corkscrew to open the vintage bottle.
clue_source.zh: 使用开瓶器打开陈年酒瓶。

solution_steps.en: Select Corkscrew, then click Wine Bottle in inventory.
solution_steps.zh: 选择开瓶器，然后点击物品栏中的酒瓶。

final_action.en: Unlock the service door next to the fireplace.
